notes: PHF HR Competition V1.4 — 'Bai toi da duyet' (reviewer-facing read-only history) + Competition notifications. (1) services/phf-hr-api/lib/competition-review.js: new myReviewedHistory() (same review_assignments/status='completed' base filter as reviewerProductivity's 'Da xu ly' count, LEFT JOIN submissions for current state + a LATERAL submission_history lookup for what the actor actually did/when, author identity never selected, same discipline as anonymousQueue); fixed completeAssignmentForReviewer's open-pool branch (an admin/other-level reviewer processing a submission whose active assignment belongs to someone else now closes out the stale assignment as 'reassigned' and records a real completed row for the ACTUAL actor, instead of only leaving an audit breadcrumb - needed for productivity/myReviewed to stay truthful and consistent). (2) New standalone competition.notifications table (migration phf_hr_competition_notification_v1.sql/_DOWN.sql, additive, already applied+verified on phf_hr_e2e and Production phf_hr independently of this app-code batch) + services/phf-hr-api/lib/competition-notification-emit.js (generic ON CONFLICT(dedupe_key) DO NOTHING emit helper, never throws) + competition-notification-read.js (list/markRead/markAllRead, recipient-identity-scoped). Wired into assignForSubmission/ensureHighAssignment/manualReassign (reviewer-assignment notification, new reviewer only, never the revoked one) and reviewAction/adjustScore (participant notification on approve/upgrade/request_revision/reject/post-approval score adjustment, recipient always server-resolved from the row's own author columns, dedupe keyed off submissions.row_version so retries never duplicate). SLA-overdue and generic admin-activity notifications explicitly out of scope (no cron/scheduler exists for processOverdueAssignments in this repo). (3) Frontend: new 'Bai toi da duyet' menu entry + screen (reuses the EXISTING adjustScore modal for privileged post-approval adjustment, never a second component) + a Competition notification bell/panel in the module topbar (badge count, mark read/mark all read, path rebuilt client-side from role+targetPath). New route /{admin,ql,hv}/thi-dua/da-duyet (reviewer-gated, same capability check as cho-duyet). No changes to scoring rules, similarity, feed, leaderboard, awards, evidence/reconciliation logic, or Task notifications. assets/css/phf-competition.css and assets/js/competition/phf-competition-app.js bumped to ?v=1.4.0_myreviewed_notifications in index.html (both already tracked in scripts/phf-check-js.js MANUAL_VERSIONED_ASSETS).
